faqs.question: Minimum order kitna hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, minimum 10 pieces se order kar sakte hain — mix and match allowed. Koi bhi product, color, size mix kar sakte ho. Jaise 3 black oversized + 4 white round neck + 3 hoodie = 10 pieces valid hai.

faqs.question: GSM kya hota hai?
faqs.answer: GSM matlab Grams per Square Meter — fabric ki thickness. 180 GSM regular tee jaisa, 210 H&M/Zara jaisa premium, 240 GSM streetwear gold standard (thick, heavy), 320 hoodie/sweatshirt, 430 sabse heavy hoodie India mein.

faqs.question: Bio-washed kya hota hai?
faqs.answer: Biowash matlab enzyme treatment — fabric extra soft, smooth aur pre-shrunk ho jati hai. Washing ke baad shrink nahi hogi, color nahi jaayega. Quality guarantee hai humari.

faqs.question: Delivery time kya hai?
faqs.answer: Delhi NCR mein 1-2 GHANTE mein (Porter/Rapido se). PAN India 1-3 din. Hum 'Dispatch within Minutes' ke liye famous hain — payment confirm hote hi dispatch.

faqs.question: COD available hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi ji, hum 100% prepaid karte hain. COD available nahi hai. UPI, Bank Transfer, ya Online Payment se pay karo. Website pe order karo toh extra Rs 2/piece discount milta hai.

faqs.question: Custom printing karte ho?
faqs.answer: Hum plain/blank banate hain — printing businesses ke liye. Screen print, DTG, DTF, sublimation, embroidery, heat press — sab ke liye optimized hai fabric. Aap apna printing karo, humse blank lo.

faqs.question: GST include hai price mein?
faqs.answer: Nahi ji, sab prices GST exclusive hain. 5% GST invoicing ke time add hota hai. GST invoice har order ke saath milta hai.

faqs.question: Oversized t-shirt ka rate kya hai?
faqs.answer: Oversized 180 GSM Rs 165, 210 GSM Rs 175, 240 GSM Rs 180 (bulk rate). Sample rate thoda zyada hota hai. 240 GSM sabse popular hai streetwear brands ke liye — 12 colors available. Sab dispatch within minutes.

faqs.question: Round neck ka rate batao?
faqs.answer: True Biowash Round Neck Rs 140, Biowash Rs 130, Non Bio Rs 102 (sabse sasta). Sab 180 GSM. True Biowash mein 13 colors hain — printing ke liye best. Sublimation tee Rs 115.

faqs.question: Hoodie ka rate kya hai?
faqs.answer: Hoodie 320 GSM Black Rs 295, Colors Rs 325. Zip Hoodie Rs 325. 430 GSM Dropshoulder Rs 380, Colors Rs 418. Sab cotton brushed fleece, ready stock.

faqs.question: Sweatshirt available hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, sweatshirt 320 GSM Rs 225 se start (Black, Navy, Grey, Army Green). Dusri range Rs 240 (Maroon, White, Off-white). Crew neck, fleece. Varsity Jacket bhi hai Rs 335.

faqs.question: Polo t-shirt hai?
faqs.answer: Ji sir, Premium Polo Rs 220 — 100% Cotton Honeycomb, 4 colors. Cotton Polo Rs 180 — 6 colors. Dono 220 GSM. Corporate/casual dono ke liye perfect.

faqs.question: Acid wash available hai?
faqs.answer: Haan ji, AcidWash Oversize 240 GSM Rs 220 bulk. French Terry fabric, vintage look. Abhi sirf Black mein available hai.

faqs.question: Sample order kaise karu?
faqs.answer: 1 piece bhi order kar sakte ho sample ke liye — Sample Price pe milega. 10+ pieces pe Bulk Price laga. bulkplaintshirt.com pe order karo ya WhatsApp karo wa.me/919336695049.

faqs.question: Factory/warehouse kahan hai?
faqs.answer: Factory Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu mein hai (manufacturing — visit allowed nahi). Delhi mein warehouse hai Khanpur, South Delhi — yahan aa ke pick up bhi kar sakte ho. Mon-Sat 10AM-6PM, Sunday 11AM-4PM.

faqs.question: Return policy kya hai?
faqs.answer: Manufacturing defect (hole, tear, stitching issue) pe replacement milta hai. WhatsApp pe photo bhejo defect ki. No shrinkage, No color bleeding — yeh humari guarantee hai.

faqs.question: Dropshipping karte ho?
faqs.answer: Haan ji! Zero-contact blind dropshipping. Hum directly tumhare customer ko dispatch karte hain — Sale91 ka koi branding/invoice nahi lagta. No setup fee, no monthly charge. WhatsApp pe order do.

faqs.question: Kids t-shirt available hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, Kids Round Neck 180 GSM Rs 110 bulk. 5 colors — Black, White, Red, Baby Pink, Mustard Yellow. Sizes 20 se 34 (age 2-12 years). True Biowash, Supercombed cotton.

faqs.question: Shorts available hai?
faqs.answer: Haan ji, Shorts 240 GSM Rs 205 bulk. 100% Cotton, heavyweight. 4 colors — Black, Off-white, Lavender, Beige. Zipper pockets, XS se XL.

faqs.question: Website pe discount milta hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, bulkplaintshirt.com pe order karo toh extra Rs 2/piece discount. Automatic apply hota hai. Plus dispatch within minutes.

faqs.question: Sublimation ke liye kaun sa tshirt?
faqs.answer: Sublimation ke liye sirf ek option hai — Sublimation T-Shirt 200 GSM Rs 115. Cotton-feel polyester hai, white color only. Full sublimation print ke liye yahi best hai.

faqs.question: Printing ke liye kaun sa tshirt best hai?
faqs.answer: DTG/Screen Print ke liye 100% cotton — Oversize 240 GSM ya True Biowash RN best. DTF sab pe chalta hai. Sublimation ke liye Sublimation Tee. Embroidery ke liye heavy GSM — Polo, Hoodie, Oversize 240. HTV bhi sab pe chalega.

faqs.question: Varsity Jacket hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, Varsity Jacket 320 GSM Rs 335 bulk. Black body, White sleeves — classic baseball style. Cotton brushed fleece. Ready stock.

faqs.question: Boxy Fit kya hai?
faqs.answer: Boxy Fit matlab square silhouette — wider chest, slightly shorter length. Streetwear trend hai. 180 GSM Rs 175 bulk. Black aur White mein available. Drop-shoulder hai.
